title: ThrownError
description: The typed error object THROWN by an in-process operation (Bindings.md). It carries the SAME closed `code` catalog and human-readable `error` as the HTTP error body (schema/error.json) — the in-process binding raises this instead of returning an HTTP status. The `code` property is reused from error.json by $ref so the two bindings can never drift.

details.description: Optional structured context (e.g. the offending field).
